component.name: debpak
component.summary: Convert Linux, Windows and Electron app packages into Flatpaks

description.p: debpak turns the packages vendors hand out into Flatpaks. It reads .deb, .rpm and Arch packages, AppImages, snaps, .run installers and plain tarballs or zips. It works out which libraries the Flatpak runtime is missing, copies in just those, writes a flatpak-builder manifest, and then builds and installs the result for your user.

It also takes apps that were never meant for Linux. An Electron app from a Windows installer or a Mac disk image gets the Linux build of Electron in place of the one it shipped with, and any other Windows program gets packaged with Wine.
Once someone has converted an app and checked that it works, the conversion can be shared as a recipe that holds only debpak's part and the vendor's download link.

debpak is a command-line tool. Run it with flatpak run io.github.spaley2011.debpak followed by a command such as inspect or convert. It builds and installs Flatpaks with the flatpak and flatpak-builder programs on your system, so flatpak-builder has to be installed there.

The first release. It converts .deb, .rpm and Arch packages, AppImages, snaps, .run installers, tarballs and zips into Flatpaks, packages Windows programs with Wine and Electron apps from Windows and macOS with Linux Electron, and installs shared recipes.
